tools.description:
Create the default store and its _shared/report-format note.

Idempotent. path must be the current working directory, the directory in
SWARMNOTES_DIR, or the project directory whose .swarmnotes is
SWARMNOTES_DIR. Any other path is an error. Returns root (the store path)
and report_format (its note id).
tools.name: relatum_init

tools.description:
List notes as id, kind, summary, and status.

scope is a directory under the store; empty lists everything. kind filters
to one of decision, constraint, convention, context, format, finding,
attempt. Superseded notes are omitted unless include_superseded is true.
tag filters to one slug. The store is .swarmnotes/ or $SWARMNOTES_DIR.

limit.description: Return at most this many notes. When notes are left out, the result                      has more (how many).
limit.title: Limit

since.description: Only notes written or changed at or after this UTC time:                      2026-11-05 or 2026-11-05T14:30:00Z. Use a modified value from an                      earlier details listing to see what is new.
since.title: Since

details.description: Also return author, updated, and modified (file time, UTC) per note.
details.title: Details

tools.name: relatum_ls

tools.description:
Fetch one or more notes by ID. Follows superseded_by, including multi-hop chains.

Returns notes (the live note, with chain) and errors (ids that failed).
Other ids are still returned when one id is missing.
tools.name: relatum_get

tools.description:
Create a note. Fails if the id already exists; never overwrites.

kind is decision, constraint, convention, context, format, finding, or
attempt. summary is one line, at most 100 characters. body is the fact
(keep it under ~300 words). tags is a list of slugs.
tools.name: relatum_new

tools.description:
Correct a note in place: replace its summary, body, or tags; updated becomes today.

For small fixes by the note's author (author must match the note's author).
To replace a note, or to change one someone else wrote, write a new note and
call relatum_supersede with old set to this note. Superseded notes cannot be edited.

author.description: Who is editing; must be the note's author.
author.title: Author

summary.description: New one-line summary, at most 100 characters.
summary.title: Summary

body.description: New body; replaces the whole body.
body.title: Body

tags.description: New tag slugs; [] removes the tags.
tags.title: Tags

tools.name: relatum_edit

tools.description:
Mark old as replaced by new. new must already exist and resolve to a live note.

Later relatum_get calls on old follow the chain. relatum_ls hides old unless
include_superseded is true.
tools.name: relatum_supersede

tools.description:
Lint every note in the store.

ok is false when there are errors. warnings (long bodies, missing author
or updated) do not fail the check. errors and warnings are the same
strings the CLI prints.
tools.name: relatum_check
